cc:Work.dc:title: Soroi eight-worker cached operation benchmarks
cc:Work.dc:description: Median aggregate cost before and after incremental group admission. Get: 29.535 vs 29.515 ns/op. Set: 38.365 vs 37.590 ns/op. Grouped workflow: 365.450 vs 371.050 ns/workflow. Group workflow five-percent regression guard remains unresolved.
